scripts.artifacts:verify:win7: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const checks=[{label:'win7 portable',file:path.resolve(process.cwd(),'release/win7/nsd-box-editor_win7.exe'),expected:['x86','x64'],minSizeMb:120},{label:'win7 unpacked',file:path.resolve(process.cwd(),'release/win7/win-unpacked/nsd-box-editor.exe'),expected:['x64'],minSizeMb:80}]; function readMachine(filePath){const fd=fs.openSync(filePath,'r'); try{const dos=Buffer.alloc(64); fs.readSync(fd,dos,0,dos.length,0); if(dos.toString('ascii',0,2)!=='MZ') throw new Error('Missing MZ header'); const peOffset=dos.readUInt32LE(0x3c); const pe=Buffer.alloc(6); fs.readSync(fd,pe,0,pe.length,peOffset); if(pe.toString('ascii',0,4)!=='PE\0\0') throw new Error('Missing PE header'); const machine=pe.readUInt16LE(4); if(machine===0x14c) return 'x86'; if(machine===0x8664) return 'x64'; if(machine===0xaa64) return 'arm64'; return `0x${machine.toString(16)}`;} finally{fs.closeSync(fd);} } let failed=false; for(const item of checks){ if(!fs.existsSync(item.file)){console.error(`[verify-win-pe] Missing: ${item.label} -> ${item.file}`); failed=true; continue;} const sizeMb=fs.statSync(item.file).size/(1024*1024); let machine='unknown'; let itemFailed=false; try{machine=readMachine(item.file);} catch(error){console.error(`[verify-win-pe] Invalid PE: ${item.label} -> ${error.message}`); failed=true; itemFailed=true;} if(!itemFailed && !item.expected.includes(machine)){console.error(`[verify-win-pe] Arch mismatch: ${item.label} -> got ${machine}, expected ${item.expected.join('/')}`); failed=true; itemFailed=true;} if(sizeMb<item.minSizeMb){console.error(`[verify-win-pe] File too small: ${item.label} -> ${sizeMb.toFixed(2)} MB, min ${item.minSizeMb} MB`); failed=true; itemFailed=true;} if(!itemFailed){console.log(`[verify-win-pe] OK: ${item.label} -> ${machine}, ${sizeMb.toFixed(2)} MB`);} } if(failed) process.exit(1); console.log('[verify-win-pe] All Win7 executable checks passed.');"
